# Obsidian vault settings

`app.json` is committed so every contributor's Obsidian creates the same kind of
link: standard Markdown (`[Text](path.md)`) with relative paths, which renders on
GitHub as well as in the vault. Do not switch this to wikilinks.

Everything else Obsidian writes here — `workspace.json`, caches, plugin state —
is per-person and Git-ignored.
